newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Samper names new transport minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Samper names new transport minister.

text.p: Colombian President Ernesto Samper named a new transportation minister on Thursday to take over from Carlos Hernan Lopez, who stepped down amid a budding scandal over his alleged abuse of office.
Sources at the ornate Casa de Narino presidential palace said Samper had tapped Hernando Monroy Valencia, a veteran civil engineer, to replace Lopez.
Valencia, 64, is a former head of the Colombian Engineering Society and a specialist in highway construction. Like Lopez, he is a member of the opposition Conservative Party.

Lopez resigned on Sunday after Attorney General Jaime Bernal Cuellar suspended him for three months, pending an investigation into his alleged use of the Transportation Ministry to engage in partisan politics.
He had recently been accused of using an official helicopter to ferry political cronies, and members of a dissident wing of the Conservative Party, to rallies in the countryside.
